name: Gamma
what: Gamma's connector: prompt-driven presentations, documents, webpages and social posts hosted on gamma.app, plus search, outline reads and natural-language edits of the user's existing gammas. Visual control is at prompt level only, and it returns no code. The tool set differs by session: the researched session had no generate, read or export tool.
install: Attach the Gamma connector in the host's connector settings, then sign in with the user's Gamma account.
firstCall: none (no init tool). Call get_gamma_outline before edit_gamma, and search_templates then get_gamma_outline on the template before generate_from_template
evidenceNote: Server instructions and the schemas of the ten exposed tools read. One live read call succeeded: search_templates. The main function was not exercised: generate, generate_from_template, get_gammas, get_folders, read_gamma and every export tool were absent from the researched session. No edit, duplicate, move, panel or feedback call ran.
